reviews.title: Friendly airline to fly with
reviews.text: It was Boeing 737 with 3-3 configuration. The flight time was 3.5 hours. The flight had inflight entertainment, good food (Two options one Mongolian and the other was Western. Pillow and blankets were not available may be because it was short haul flight.
reviews.author: Suddhasattwa M

reviews.title: Terrible service and communication
reviews.text: I had one back bag and cabin luggage with me but had to pay 80 euros at the last minute for my 8kg cabin luggage just before boarding my plane. I feel totally scammed!!!
reviews.author: Uugii M

reviews.title: Lack of management
reviews.text: Is a terrible airline, seems all true in comments. I want to buy for UB from FRankfurt a flight compare with Turkish the price and MIAT don't respond to emails, is no customer service support and not even able to buy online ticket. I speak german and I've tried to call Berlin office and nobody never replies. Emails from Offcial browser MIAT comes back as wrong adresses. I travel a lot, but never heard such nonsense. ALL EU are half billion citizen and you're not even able to buy online tickets. Food in pics is terrible and seems no entertainemnt on board. I have conversation with MIAT on meseengear.
reviews.author: Cosmin Pitesteanu

reviews.title: Flight delayed
reviews.text: I had a delay of 7.5 hours, i only got a 20 dollar voucher for food. I want all the money back from the flight or i will undergo actions. Shame yourself
reviews.author: Badyo

reviews.title: Short vacation
reviews.text: The worst airline in the world. Charged for carry on bag and sent through check in. When I got to my final destination there is no baggage. Can you believe when someone is on vacation and they don’t even have their personal belongings. That sucks…..never recommend this flight to anyone..period…
reviews.author: namgyel w

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: I know if difficult time for everyone but that not justify not service in a 10 h flight just water and a dry /hard croissant, no entertainment and the space between rows are to small that I barely fit ( I am 5’7) The ground service is terrible on both way. I travel a lot and never been in a airline with such a bad service
reviews.author: Soraida M

reviews.title: The best choice to fly to Ulaanbaatar from Hong Kong
reviews.text: It was just like any other flight to me. It kinds of only way, or very limited choice to fly to Ulaanbaatar, so of course it was a bit more expensive, I guessed. My flight was normal as any others.
reviews.author: Hai N

reviews.title: First time and amazing
reviews.text: First time in Business Class with this airline and i was absolutely impressed with the service and quality of the food presented. Short flight of just over 2 hours but well worth the experience. I have also travelled economy with this airline and while it doesn't match BC, it still is better than most other short haul lines. Recommended when you are going to Mongolia. Mongolia in itself is well worth a look at.
reviews.author: Russell T

reviews.title: Hit or Miss with Miat Mongolia
reviews.text: I originally flew to Mongolia on Aeroflot, then transferred in Moscow to Miat Mongolia. That trip was a miss. They changed the gate to the furthest one back of the airport. I was so worried about missing my connection. But it turned out that the flight was late, I ended up waiting to board for an hour, which meant the people waiting to pick me up waited for over an hour for me. My luggage, (along with half the passengers of that flight) did not make it. I did receive my luggage the next day. When the guy in front of me put his seat back, he was literally in my lap. I couldn't open my tray table or shift in my seat. So 90 days later I was sent to South Korea. I call it a "visa run". If you leave Mongolia for a day and return, your 90 days are reset, and you get another 90 days. This is for Americans, I don't know about visa restrictions for other countries. That flight was a hit. The plane left pretty much ontime, flight was uneventful, arrived safely and was more comfortable than my first experience. The food was alright as far as airplane food goes. The only problem I had was that as it was a small airline it shared space with two other airlines at the airport. I couldn't check in until right before the flight. Which means as my flight was late, all the cool shops were closed by time I got to the gate side. I also had to ask someone since I didn't see the airlines in the check-in and was confused. When I did check-in it was fine and the flight was on time. I had meal service
reviews.author: Global768312

reviews.title: Ok, mediocre
reviews.text: Check-in and baggage-drop was ok and flight was on time. The service in business class was a bit disappointing as the food equaled the food which is served in economy class of better airline (e.g. Singapore or Emirates). Otherwise, cabin crew was very friendly. No individual TV screens.
reviews.author: Pinga123

reviews.title: Things to improve!
reviews.text: Not one of MIAT's better flights. The flight got off to a surprisingly good start, leaving a full three minutes ahead of the scheduled departure time! But, the 767-300ER plane was poorly maintained, with the seat pocket torn and falling away from the seat in front of me and the volume control for in-flight entertainment broken. No choice of meal provided (and what was provided wasn't anything to write home about). Flight crew was OK.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Smooth flight from Seoul!
reviews.text: Left a little late, but flight itself was smooth and comfortable. Plane (767-300ER) was clean and comfortable.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Lots of leg room
reviews.text: The plane had ashtrays. This instantly fired off alarm bells for its age!!! The seats were shabby and the whole plane looked like it needed to retire! The check in process at UB was substandard! multiple lines and lots of stress!
reviews.author: star2450

reviews.title: Fuss free-Frills free
reviews.text: With the poor reviews I read online before my trip, I was pretty nervous about the flight. Having done it, it is my opinion that the reviews given were somewhat harsh. Though not a fancy ride, it was not terrible. Meals were acceptable and journey smooth. The major drawbacks were the luggage weight limit of 23kg and lack of entertainment onboard.
reviews.author: Julie N

reviews.title: Good service but no entry documents
reviews.text: I was surprised and the comfort and efficiency of the airline. Not all developing countries have a good infrastructure, but Miat seems to, at least on the international flights. Attendants were friendly and spoke English and/or Korean. The economy seats were roomy and comfortable. There was a free movie and dinner on a three hour flight. The food was airline food; I have had worse. My only complaint is that they have no entry documents out. I am used to airlines doing this when it is required. When I received no documents my brain went into Europe mode and I thought there were none needed. Entry forms and customer form were available at passport control, but it was a mad scramble with the other passengers.
reviews.author: Heidi D

reviews.title: Good window seat
reviews.text: Lucky to have a seat near the front of economy section which provided a clear view once clear of the HK clouds. It was a fantastic sigt to fly across northern China and then for 2 hours or more across the Gobi desert towards UB as the locals call Ulaanbaatar. It was a clear sky day and we had excellent views all the way for about 4 hours. See the Gobi for the first time is a sight like no other, the dry and dusty flat lands with trails across the desert, maybe unchanged since the original silk road.
reviews.author: Murray L

reviews.title: Comfortable and on time
reviews.text: Well organised service in a comfortable modern 737 that left on time and arrived early. Slightly officious crew and bumpy landing but all good!
reviews.author: OnwardTraveller

reviews.title: Horror trip
reviews.text: We have been stuck in the Frankfurt airport for more than 20 hours. Incompetence of the airline is beyond reason. Since Saturday midday we have been delayed numerous times with no clear explanation.... latest announcement delayed flight by 4 h due to the lack of food on the plane..... this airline is simply ridiculous!!! Very likely we will spend another day at the Frankfurt airport .... no view on actual departure
reviews.author: Piotr K

reviews.title: Even better flight, service and food
reviews.text: This was a larger plane than our first flight so had the additional benefit of seatback screens and slightly better legroom. Food was better as well. Service was also good. This was a better timed flight as often the flights to HKG leave very early in the morning except, apparently, on a Monday.
reviews.author: Grumpybrother

reviews.title: Surprisingly good
reviews.text: Small plane, good service and the food was acceptable. This is a 4 hour flight, but the plane we were on was one of those small ones so the entertainment was the drop down screens with no choice of what to watch. Luckily we were prepared so I had brought reading matter. Because we had been prewarned about the food we made sure that we had extra snacks with us which were very welcome.
reviews.author: Grumpybrother

reviews.title: Great food and staff
reviews.text: Flew with Mongolian airlines to and from HK. The first flight ended up being delayed by 7 hours and it was hard to get ongoing info about this - due to high winds and storms. Miat do not provide food/accommodation for such events. However flight, food and service good. Aircraft a little down at heel.
reviews.author: tes108

reviews.title: Everything was just great.
reviews.text: Easy, hasslefree checkin. I was not allowed to pick a seat, but the airline gave med a good one. Modern aircraft, nice service. It is amazing that a small (population wise) nation can have such a great airline. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Vlad W

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: This was my first time flying with Miat - the aircraft was new, seats were reasonably spaced and the flight was on time. The cabin service was also good - I would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: Margaret W

reviews.title: Fair price, good service
reviews.text: It was my second flight with MIAT after the flight to Ulaanbaatar two weeks earlier. Only five passengers in business class and plenty of space there. The airplane has left ULN on time and arrived to TXL on time. The seats are comfortable; not fully flat (horizontal) but as good as in other airplanes of the same standard. Quality of food was good; the dishes could be better (some plastic ... but not really woth to claim about). The stewardesses are very kind and they have frequently asked me if I would desire anything. In general: Perfect!
reviews.author: Roland Martini

reviews.title: New meaning to cattle class
reviews.text: Forget this mob if over 6ft, seats are jammed in with no leg room. Departure from Ulaanbaatar was a disorganized scrum. Service on the plane was so so with staff not looking like they were all that enthused . The food was at best passable, a huge wad of mashed potato with a few bits of meat and sad beans. Probably not the best experience.
reviews.author: SEAchange2018

reviews.title: Friendly and  very helpful cabin crew
reviews.text: Normally there are 2 flights from Incheon to Ulaanbator daily. I chose to reach Ulaanbator earlier i.e. by 5pm local time so I chose MIAT (alternatively - Korean Air, to reach Ulaanbator by 9.55pm) Overall experience of the 4 hour flight was fine despite uncontrollable weather conditions ( very bright sun but cloudy outside and still had turbulence every hour). I sat next to 3x young mothers with toddlers yesterday and saw how the young male flight attendant(s) at Row 9DEF being genuinely attentive so that the mothers can managed their toddlers and not cry or wail the entire flight. Bringing kids kit, bringing hot food for both mother and kid, giving hot water every hour or so, talking to the toddlers, etc. Most airlines will warn you about turbulence after the plane started shaking, but Miat was very quick in announcing ahead so that everyone is prepared. Perhaps the pilots really know every spot of the journey as they fly the same route every day. Landing appears difficult but once it touched down, everything was just fine and well! Hot food is not bad and quite fresh. Despite the plane being not new and not equipped with the latest entertainment, other good factors did make up for it.
reviews.author: CeeWiAr

reviews.title: Poor Quality Food
reviews.text: I regularly fly between Hong Kong and Ulaanbaatar. There are two types of plane used by MIAT on this route. One type has a drop down screen every few rows, one type has a small screen on the back of the seat. Bring a tablet or book in case you get the plane with the drop down screen. The quality of the food on this flight is always poor. I eat at the Hong Kong airport before the flight.
reviews.author: Mike P

reviews.title: Typical average airline
reviews.text: MIAT is the only international airline in Mongolia, it is state owned company. The service is good for small airlines.
reviews.author: Aanjaa M

reviews.title: They have the best service
reviews.text: I have flied with so many airlines companies. I think they are the best. The staff is very friendly, speak all good in english, food was delicious and the seat was very comfortable. Also the pilot was the best.. congratulations to all.. actually I was not expecting that
reviews.author: Simone

reviews.title: Specialist of flying in Mongolian sky
reviews.text: The flight was on time and very sufficient to travel to Mongolia. Environment in the cabin was quite fair and provided reasonable meal service. Only concern 737-800 aircraft was bit old and leg space was limited like LCC. The airline is under replacing those to new ones, 737-MAX8, which are now on the ground. Anyway It was enough goodness to fly on such short flight and environment on Chinese routes, where we sometimes experience some difficulties.
reviews.author: momiji2018
